clue.text: Sink and give up without oxygen

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the word for giving up wraps around the gas symbol

parts.note: to give up a habit is to stop it
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: Someone sinking in thin air gives up for lack of oxygen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it means 'outside': STOP goes around O.
explanation.definitionFit: To stoop is to lower oneself or bend down, a sense close to sinking.

clue.text: Hardest areas to go round? This must be one of them!

definitions.text: This must be one of them

indicators.note: go round tells us to turn the letters of the phrase about

explanation.surface: Asking which regions are toughest to cross, and pointing to a prime example.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on the first half: one of the hardest areas to go round.
explanation.definitionFit: The great North African desert is notoriously one of the hardest places on earth to cross.

clue.text: Ape needs drink, lacking energy

indicators.note: lacking means the drink loses the physics symbol

parts.note: orange is a fruit drink
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: A tired ape needs a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Orang is a short form of orang-utan, the great ape.

clue.text: Having love maybe is unprofitable

definitions.meaning: love is zero in tennis scoring, so a player on love has nothing on the board
a useless effort that achieves nothing

explanation.definitionFit: Without points, as a player on love, and without purpose, as an unprofitable effort.

clue.text: Bloom is rather powdery, might you suppose?

parts.note: flour is the powdery stuff of baking, standing for the powder itself
the suffix -ish means rather or somewhat

explanation.surface: A gardener wonders whether a dusty-looking bloom is powdery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might you suppose?' admits the whimsy: 'rather powdery' read as flour-ish.
explanation.definitionFit: A flourish is a showy display or a period of thriving, as in a bloom of success.

clue.text: When I had a cook round?

indicators.note: the cooking word goes round the contraction and the article

parts.note: to fry is to cook
I'd is the contraction of I had

explanation.surface: Asking at what time the speaker had a cook come over.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a day as an answer to 'when?'; Robinson Crusoe's servant Friday lurks too.
explanation.definitionFit: A day of the week is one answer to the question of when something happens.

clue.text: Maiden cheated? That's by no means rare!

parts.note: in cricket a maiden is an over with no runs scored, so maiden stands for over
done is slang for cheated or swindled

explanation.surface: A young woman has been swindled, and that is not rare at all.
explanation.walkthrough: A maiden over is a cricket over of six balls with no runs scored.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat cooked too long is far from rare, the opposite of underdone.

clue.text: Joint is right good place for hops

parts.note: an oast is a kiln where hops are dried

explanation.surface: A pub claims to be a good place for hops.
explanation.walkthrough: An OAST is a kiln for drying hops, common in Kent; 'is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A roast is a joint of meat cooked in the oven.

clue.text: She's large to manoeuvre, so get lifting gear

indicators.note: to manoeuvre is to move about, so the letters are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: She is too big to move without lifting equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheerlegs or shearlegs are a hoisting frame of two poles used to lift heavy loads.

clue.text: Team put down in more demanding region high up

indicators.note: the team and the word for putting down are placed inside the comparative adjective

parts.note: heavier work is more demanding
a side is a sports team
to lay something is to put it down

explanation.surface: A team is dropped into a tougher division higher up the league.
explanation.definitionFit: This ionised layer of the upper atmosphere, which reflects radio waves, is a region far above the earth.

clue.text: Three schools set out a framework for home economics

indicators.note: set out means arranged afresh, so the letters are laid out anew

explanation.surface: Three schools draw up a syllabus for domestic science.
explanation.definitionFit: A frame for drying washing is household equipment, a practical framework in domestic life.

clue.text: Most helpful report of ceremony received involving knight

indicators.note: a report is something heard, so the word for a ceremony is taken by its sound

parts.note: a rite is a ceremony

indicators.note: the word for received surrounds the chess abbreviation

parts.note: to have had something is to have received it
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A newspaper account of an investiture ceremony in which a knight is dubbed.
explanation.definitionFit: A right-hand man is one's most helpful and trusted assistant.

clue.text: What comes in glory travelling around mountainous area

indicators.note: around turns the selected run of letters back to front
the letters that come within the phrase glory travelling are taken

explanation.surface: Travelling in glory through an alpine region.
explanation.walkthrough: The run LORYT sits inside 'glory travelling'; 'around' turns it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tyrol is an alpine region of western Austria and northern Italy.

clue.text: Sweet musical item keeps class back

indicators.note: keeps means the musical piece holds the reversed letters inside it

parts.note: a duet is a piece of music for two

indicators.note: back tells us to read the abbreviation for class the other way round

parts.note: CL is a standard abbreviation for class

explanation.surface: A sweet musical number holds back the rest of the class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' signals a reversal of the class abbreviation only; 'musical item' is a piece for two performers, not a single song.
explanation.definitionFit: Dulcet describes sweet, soothing sounds, as in dulcet tones.

clue.text: No burial at sea for high-ranking German

parts.note: a burial not at sea is one on land, a land grave
a burial not at sea is one on land, a land grave

explanation.surface: A German noble insists on being buried ashore.
explanation.definitionFit: A landgrave was a count with territorial rule in the Holy Roman Empire.

clue.text: First half of show, man, is poor

indicators.note: only the first half of the word for show is kept, the other four letters dropped

parts.note: to indicate is to show
gent is short for gentleman, a man

explanation.surface: In the first half of the show a man is revealed as penniless.
explanation.walkthrough: INDICATE loses CATE, its second half, leaving INDI.
explanation.definitionFit: Indigent is a formal word for poor or needy.

clue.text: One man's vocal quality is suitable for rock

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
Ron's: a man's name with the possessive
tone is the quality of a voice

explanation.surface: A singer's voice is right for rock music.
explanation.definitionFit: Ironstone is a sedimentary rock rich in iron.

clue.text: Gesture after race when you're desperate to cool off?

definitions.text: when you're desperate to cool off

indicators.note: the gesture comes after the race in the answer

parts.note: a heat is a qualifying race
a wave is a hand gesture

explanation.surface: Waving after the race, a runner longs to cool down.
explanation.definitionFit: A spell of very hot weather is exactly when people long to cool down.

clue.text: Forbidding member of family to go outside home

indicators.note: the relative is to go round the word meaning at home

parts.note: a sister is a family member
in means at home

explanation.surface: A relative is banned from leaving the house.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinister means threatening or ominous, much as a forbidding look is.

clue.text: Sweet little creature protecting son

indicators.note: protecting means the creature surrounds and shields the abbreviation for son

parts.note: a mouse is a small animal

explanation.surface: A small animal watches over its offspring.
explanation.definitionFit: A mousse is a light, airy dessert, served as a sweet course.

clue.text: County clique may have upset staff initially

indicators.note: the upturned staff comes first, before the clique
upset in a down clue turns the word for staff upside down

parts.note: a rod is a staff
a set is a social clique

explanation.surface: A group from the shire may have upset the staff from the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Dorset is a county on the south coast of England.

clue.text: Star in dress starts to excite luvvies

parts.note: rig means clothing or to dress

indicators.note: the beginnings of the next two words are taken

explanation.surface: A star in a stunning outfit gets the theatrical crowd excited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'luvvies' is British slang for actors, effusive theatre types.
explanation.definitionFit: Rigel is a bright star in the constellation Orion.

clue.text: I may be after a strip club

indicators.note: the letter I is placed after the strip

parts.note: a lath is a thin strip of wood

explanation.surface: Someone could follow on from a strip club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strip club' reads as one thing, but the definition is just 'club'.
explanation.definitionFit: A lathi is a heavy iron-bound stick used as a club by Indian police.

clue.text: Correct basis of conduct is needed by every individual PM

parts.note: the Tao, in Chinese philosophy, is the right way or principle of conduct
taken as written
each means every individual one

explanation.surface: Principles of right behaviour are demanded of every single prime minister.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tao is the Way of Taoism, the principle of right living.
explanation.definitionFit: The Taoiseach is the prime minister of the Republic of Ireland.

clue.text: Keep performing somewhere in London

parts.note: to act on is to keep on acting, carrying on with a performance
to act on is to keep on acting, carrying on with a performance

explanation.surface: An actor wants to stay on stage in a London venue.
explanation.definitionFit: Acton is a district of west London.

clue.text: Vehicle ran into others next to hospital worker

indicators.note: into places the verb inside the word for other vehicles

parts.note: in a clue about a vehicle, the others are other vehicles: carts
taken as written
a porter moves patients and equipment around a hospital

explanation.surface: A vehicle collides with others beside a hospital porter.
explanation.walkthrough: The space after CAR hides the join: the verb sits inside the other vehicles, and the answer splits three letters in.
explanation.definitionFit: A car transporter is a lorry built to carry several cars at once.

clue.text: Organise this person to follow soldier into chasm

indicators.note: the soldier and the setter's self go inside the word for a chasm

parts.note: a rent is a split or gap

indicators.note: the word for the speaker comes after the soldier

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
the setter speaking of themselves: me

explanation.surface: Someone is ordered to follow a soldier down into a ravine.
explanation.definitionFit: To regiment is to organise strictly, as in a regimented routine.

clue.text: Man making name in country after revolution

indicators.note: the abbreviation for name goes inside the reversed country
a revolution turns the country's name round

parts.note: Eire is the Irish name for Ireland

explanation.surface: A man makes his name in a country after an uprising.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after revolution' turns EIRE into ERIE; N goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Ernie is a man's first name, a pet form of Ernest.
